name: Endless Night
source:
Centuries have passed since the Sun vanished from the sky in a terrible cataclysm, leaving the world stuck in time in an Endless Night.

After wandering alone in a deserted world for a long time, a certain woman returns to the only city left standing in hopes of finding the truth about the person she lost.
